kpis_story.description_fr: Cycle SNF post-COVID en 3 phases : (1) crise occupancy 2020-2021, (2) operator distress 2022-2023, (3) recovery 2024-2025+. Wave demographic (Boomers 75+) accélère 2025-2030 = tailwind structurel.
kpis_story.description_en: Post-COVID SNF cycle in 3 phases: (1) 2020-2021 occupancy crisis, (2) 2022-2023 operator distress, (3) 2024-2025+ recovery. Demographic wave (Boomers 75+) accelerates 2025-2030 = structural tailwind.

_notes: Pure-play SNF REIT. Source: 10-K FY24 filed Feb 2025.
